provenance_audit.audio_blocker_reason: Zero/silent audio signals rejected in Phase 12B without fabricating fake vectors.

experiment_b_cross_modal_alignment.generalization_limitation: N=17 is an exploratory sample; overfitting cannot be ruled out with 11 training videos. Generalization cannot be scientifically asserted for production.

experiment_c_user_personalization_compat.reason: Dimension mismatch (512 vs 2048) and incompatible embedding spaces.
experiment_c_user_personalization_compat.clip_incompatibility_reason: Equal dimensionality (512-D) does NOT imply semantic compatibility. CLIP thumbnail features exist in OpenAI visual space, while user profiles exist in Phase 8C co-engagement text space.
experiment_c_user_personalization_compat.decision: Cross-modal user-profile ranking disabled in production defaults. Text-only personalization strictly preserved.

production_weights_recommendation.rationale: Visual features are exploratory (N=17); audio features are unavailable (0 catalog coverage). Production weights must remain zero until large-scale multimodal supervision is verified.
